# Independent exact-reference and retirement review

**Verdict: PASS for all 36 current exact reference runs, the partial ledger and byte-exact portable evidence, and the two scoped completed-cache retirements. Full app, native, workspace CI and lead merge remain separate gates.**

Candidate `4fb7a80eacc598a786b4b98c809d1df24a1b02ee`. Protected baseline `0d72037ca895893e8cf338d5ade8b37b1bb645b8` is retained byte-for-byte for both metadata files and matches their Git blobs. The current manifest is identical to that baseline. Of **95 selected original methods**, the ledger records **20 ported, 16 adapted, 59 unported; 36 passing and 59 not run**. Previous 35 statuses, reasons, target/source identities and exact commands are preserved. Other unported rows are unchanged; only `ModelVersionsTest.checkSupportsParallelSync` gains ported/passing credit. Census remains partial and mirrors unverified.

Independently checked **7 UI followed by 29 tooling** exact normal Cargo commands, successful exits, named single-test results (**1 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored** each), raw hashes, source/manifest hashes and at-execution artifact bindings. Exact filters select one method and do not credit unselected tests. UI binds the earlier fresh default UI ELF. Tooling binds five fresh current default targets from a normal no-run preflight, which adds no execution credit. Compiler JSON uses absolute current-checkout paths and fresh=false; the default preflight uses no helper. Generated paths need not persist after documented retirement or rebuild.

The complete pinned `ModelVersionsTest.kt` SHA `9239c0688b3066bf964d801ba7b231dd5f70719a97331645fd53f10060252aef` is unchanged. All **nine ordered AGP/expected-support assertions**, signed-minimum producer, empty description, absent original consumer and Apache attribution match the Rust port. Supplemental tests receive no additional original parity credit.

Portable manifest SHA `9d1c7592e517839e374133ab849342e14f49c2c3792aa3dcff858e03bf36166a` binds **133 payloads, 5,091,068 bytes**. Every payload's full bytes, size and digest match its original external source. The retained frozen validator exits 0 and reports the 95/36 partial matrix. All **4,730** source/fixture hashes, fixed-seven checks, exact snapshot and preflight before/after guards pass.

UI retirement matches the independently reviewed **451,815,736-byte** ELF `ff714b206f2f4c062680f85ada3714812ee21b1bd36c4f0b4830fa9d58450b1a` after 125 plus seven exact passes. Unit retirement matches the independently reviewed **303,989,152-byte** ELF `cc057a4cfa9df4f9eacda0b581803c9062697db9edd4cfd4c0c651ab86512ea1` after 261 plus 36 plus validator passes. Before/after records preserve every prior ownership, identity, process-observation and source-guard fact, except the expected retired flag transition false to true; new post-unlink facts are appended. Both preserve one-link regular-file checks, accessible no-FD observations, inaccessible UID0 service limits and the retained frozen policy binary. No whole-system no-FD or broad removal claim is inferred. The owner’s unit preparation syntax failure and invalid script remain preserved; it fails parsing before actions and corrected scripts parse.

Two initial reviewer assertions had incorrect bookkeeping assumptions: tools-first concatenation and an invariant retired flag. Both failed before writes or product actions. The corrected independent checks establish the required UI-first ordering and exact before/after transition, retaining all previously successful command, raw-byte, assertion, ledger and source checks. No product test or acceptance criterion changed.

The reviewer ran no Cargo, compiler, test, helper, app, Gradle or native flow and mutated no source/cache/Git state or original raw record. Only this external addendum was written. Full app/native, workspace CI, protected merge, remaining 59 selected originals and exhaustive census require separate gates.
